answer: Each identity locks 70 bonds in an onyx-sealed vault and tends one willow cutting. Each epoch the vault wants a behavior fingerprint: a willow reading: height, leaf count, moisture with a fresh onyx serial. Auditors recheck it against the growth table; a mismatch, a reused serial, or a rented willow burns the bond. First fingerprint 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000, plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent tends one willow, pays 38 once.
